name: Savory Ground Turkey or Beef Keema (Mild)
whyItWorks: Finely ground meat simmered in broth with warm, non-chili seasonings (cumin, turmeric, coriander) and peeled, fork-soft diced potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer ground turkey or beef in chicken broth with soy sauce, turmeric, and cumin alongside peeled, finely diced red potatoes until fork-crumbling soft.
